summary: Kandal M Venture Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of an extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement. The meeting, scheduled for September 22, 2026, will consider a share consolidation proposal effective October 13, 2026, consolidating 40 ordinary shares into one share, reducing authorized shares from 5 billion to 125 million. No premium, per-share price, or acquisition/divestiture is involved. The company is a Cayman-incorporated, Cambodia-based leather manufacturer trading on NASDAQ. This is a routine corporate action (reverse split) requiring shareholder approval, not a special situation. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and trading adjustments post-consolidation.
